visual.general_description: Grayscale axial CT slice of the abdomen in a soft-tissue window with contrast enhancement.
visual.detailed_description: Axial cross-section of the abdomen shown on a black background. Two bright rounded kidneys lie on either side of the spine at the lower part of the image, with bright round vessel-like structures near the midline in front of the vertebral body. A large uniformly gray organ occupies the left side of the image and gas-containing and soft-tissue bowel structures with surrounding darker fat occupy the upper and right parts. Bright white curved marks lie along the lateral skin edges. No printed text, arrows, labels or measurement markers are visible apart from a very small white mark at the bottom-left corner.
